title: M5 StickS3 Agora Voice Agent
tagline: Pocket ESP32-S3 voice agent on M5StickS3 with Agora Conversational AI.
description: Build and flash an ESP-IDF voice client on M5Stack StickS3 (and StopWatch) that talks to Agora Conversational AI through a small FastAPI control service over your LAN.
author: Dylan Luo
